mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments (booking_id, payment_no, amount, status) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{paymentNo}, #{amount}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payments WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM payments WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT p.id FROM payments p INNER JOIN booking_lock b ON b.id = p.booking_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND b.status = 'PENDING' AND b.expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY b.expires_at, p.id LIMIT #{limit}
